ValidationRule.description: Every non-native waiver carries a source URL; Drive waivers carry the file id.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND(NOT(ISPICKVAL(Source_System__c, "Salesforce")), ISBLANK(Source_URL__c)), AND(ISPICKVAL(Source_System__c, "Google Drive"), ISBLANK(Drive_File_Id__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Source URL is required unless Source System is Salesforce, and Drive waivers need the Drive File Id.
